name: Halfling
reviewNotes: Walking Speed reduced to 25 feet in the approved comparative Species review; overall balance remains open.

Approved biological revision: Second Chance (reaction reroll of a visible attacker's hit, recharging on initiative or Short/Long Rest) and Bountiful Luck (reaction to share a natural-1 reroll with a visible ally within 30 feet, suspending own Luck Reroll until the end of the next turn). Original feat ability-score increases are not granted; provisional costs 4 and 3.
